in_marathi.name: Devajyoti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devajyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devajyoti is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words Deva (God) and Jyoti (Light). The name signifies 'God's Light' or 'Divine Light'. In Hindu mythology, the Gods are believed to be the source of light, wisdom, and truth. Devajyoti is thus a powerful name, bestowed with divine blessings and virtues.
